scope.purpose: Remove selection arbitrariness by locking a geometry classifier and upper-bound constants for phi_eff

tetrahedral.note: 3D hard-sphere close-packing density (Kepler limit); used as conservative upper bound for tetrahedral dilution factor.

bent.note: Conservative bound used for compact bent triad/void sharing in the Step7 dilution regime.

trigonal_pyramidal.note: Conservative bound used for trigonal pyramidal dilution regime (between 3D and planar limits).

linear.note: No volumetric dilution assumed for strictly linear diatomics in this bound table.

definitions.P_avg_atom: Stoichiometry-weighted average of atomic P_idx values for the elements in the molecular formula

notes.gate_policy: This gate checks only the locked target molecules (CH4/H2O/NH3) and treats phi_eff constants as conservative upper bounds, not fitted per-molecule parameters.
